b2-borkultura-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Banquets at King Matthias's Court
b2-borkultura-01.scenario: In a food museum in Budapest, a guide asks you how the cooks of King Matthias's court prepared the game and the oxen.
b2-borkultura-01.prompt: Tell the guide how the game meat was cooked and how the oxen were roasted.
cues: Say how the game meat was cooked
Say how the oxen were roasted on the spit
b2-borkultura-01.target: A konyhamesterek a vadhúst órákon át puhára párolták. Az ökröt a nyárson aranybarnára sütötték.
b2-borkultura-01.english: The head cooks braised the game meat tender for hours. The ox was roasted golden brown on the spit.
b2-borkultura-01.canDo: I can describe the culinary traditions of Renaissance Hungary and King Matthias's royal banquets.

b2-borkultura-02.title: Communicative Challenge: In a Tokaj Cellar
b2-borkultura-02.scenario: In a cellar in Tokaj-Hegyalja, the guide asks how aszú is made and what the wine you have just tasted is like.
b2-borkultura-02.prompt: Tell the guide how the aszú berries are gathered and what the wine is like.
cues: Say how the berries are gathered
b2-borkultura-02.target: Az aszúszemeket egyenként gyűjtik a puttonyokba. Az aszú olyan gazdag, mintha mézet kóstolnánk.
b2-borkultura-02.english: The aszú berries are gathered one by one into the puttonyos. The aszú is so rich as if we were tasting honey.
b2-borkultura-02.canDo: I can describe how Tokaji aszú is made and what it tastes like.

b2-borkultura-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Gundel and Dobos
b2-borkultura-03.scenario: In a café in Budapest, a friend asks you what Gundel Károly and Dobos C. József changed in Budapest cooking.
b2-borkultura-03.prompt: Tell your friend what Gundel Károly did and how the top of the Dobos cake was made.
cues: Say how the top of the Dobos cake was made
b2-borkultura-03.target: Gundel Károly a francia konyha technológiáját a magyar alapanyagokkal ötvözte. A Dobos-torta tetejét aranybarnára karamellizálták.
b2-borkultura-03.english: Károly Gundel combined the technique of French cooking with Hungarian ingredients. The top of the Dobos cake was caramelised golden brown.
b2-borkultura-03.canDo: I can say what Gundel Károly and Dobos C. József changed in Budapest cooking.

b2-borkultura-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Restaurants After the War
b2-borkultura-04.scenario: In a museum exhibition about the 1950s, the guide asks what changed in Hungarian restaurants after the war.
b2-borkultura-04.prompt: Tell the guide what happened to the private restaurants and what the central recipe books did.
cues: Say what happened to the private restaurants
Say what the uniform recipe books did
b2-borkultura-04.target: A magánéttermeket államosították. Az egységes receptkönyvek szabványosították az ételeket.
b2-borkultura-04.english: The private restaurants were nationalised. The uniform recipe books standardised the dishes.
b2-borkultura-04.canDo: I can explain the postwar nationalization of restaurants and the uniform recipe books.

b2-borkultura-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Hungarian Kitchen
b2-borkultura-05.scenario: In a restaurant in Budapest, a friend asks you why people talk about a gastronomic revolution.
b2-borkultura-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the young chefs broke with and how they cook meat now.
cues: Say what the young chefs broke with
Say how they cook the meat
b2-borkultura-05.target: A fiatal séfek szakítottak a szocialista tömegétkeztetéssel. A húst omlósra párolják.
b2-borkultura-05.english: The young chefs broke with socialist mass catering. They braise the meat until tender.
b2-borkultura-05.canDo: I can describe the 21st-century Hungarian gastronomic revolution and artisan winemaking.

b2-borkultura-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Cooking Through the Centuries
b2-borkultura-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a food-history tour in Budapest, the guide asks you to compare the kitchen of King Matthias with the kitchen of today.
b2-borkultura-consolidation.prompt: Tell the guide how meat was cooked at Matthias's court and how today's chefs cook it.
cues: Say how the meat was cooked at Matthias's court
Say how today's chefs cook the meat
b2-borkultura-consolidation.target: Mátyás udvarában a húst puhára párolták. A mai séfek a húst omlósra párolják.
b2-borkultura-consolidation.english: At Matthias's court the meat was braised tender. Today's chefs braise the meat until it is tender.
b2-borkultura-consolidation.canDo: I can summarize Hungarian culinary history from King Matthias to the modern chefs.
